newsitem.title: USA: Great Western says criticism is wrong.
newsitem.headline: Great Western says criticism is wrong.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said Monday that criticism of the pooling-of-interests accounting in its planned merger with Washington Mutual Inc is "without foundation."
Great Western was responding to claims made earlier by H.F. Ahmanson and Co.
Ahmanson had said in a press release that an attorney representing Great Western said the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is considering questions raised by Ahmanson about the pooling.

"The statements attributed to an attorney representing Great Western in the Delaware Chancery Court last week are absolutetly false, a gross misrepresentation of what was said, and totally inaccurate as to conclusion and import," Great Western said.
Great Western said accountants for it and Washington Mutual have advised that the accounting is appropriate.
